scope: Defects discovered from production MCP wire observations outside the 17-item analyzer correctness ledger.

defects.title: Advertised structured outputSchema required fields were omitted from structuredContent
defects.rootCause: The SDK-generated output schema marks nullable record constructor properties without defaults as required, while the SDK runtime serializer omits null POCO properties by default.
defects.misleadingRisk: A client or LLM can trust outputSchema and receive a response that is invalid against it; omitted evidence-boundary fields can also be mistaken for unsupported semantics instead of an explicit null measurement.

recursiveProductionStdioAudit.validation: recursive required/nullability/type traversal through object properties, arrays, additionalProperties, and local JSON Pointer $ref

repair.strategy: For successful tools with an advertised outputSchema only, recursively materialize a missing required property as explicit null when and only when that property's schema allows null; synchronize the text JSON with structuredContent. Never fabricate missing non-null values.
repair.nonStructuredCompatibilityBoundary: The other 56 tools have no outputSchema and never enter the repair path, so their legacy text serialization remains unchanged.
